profileZone.title: Your time zone
profileZone.body: TravStats uses your time zone to work out which day today is, whether a trip is planned or already over, and how long until you leave. Your account has none yet — until you confirm one, UTC is used for this. It does not change the times of your trips: those always show the local time of the airport, station or port.

unreachable.flightProvider: If {{name}} does not answer, the flight search asks the next service you have set up; if none answers, it names the reason and you enter the flight by hand. Saved flights stay as they are, and automatic updates try again on their next run.
unreachable.aerodatabox: If AeroDataBox does not answer, the flight search asks the next service you have set up — for flights further back there is no other; “Refresh existing flights” counts such flights as failed. Saved flights stay as they are.
unreachable.routing: If the routing service does not answer, new legs stay straight lines; they can be routed again later from the leg list. Hand-drawn legs are not touched.
unreachable.rail: If the timetable services do not answer, the train-number search finds nothing and the ride is entered by hand. Saved rides stay as they are.
unreachable.immich: If Immich cannot be reached, linked albums show no pictures and an import stops with a message. Photos copied into TravStats stay visible.
unreachable.dawarich: If Dawarich cannot be reached, a track import stops with a message, and the nightly country-day sync carries on the next night where it stopped. Existing tracks stay.
unreachable.strava: If Strava does not answer, importing activities stops with a message. Tours already taken over stay.
unreachable.openData: If one of these services does not answer, the view concerned says so; weather already saved stays, and the next time it is opened it is asked again.
unreachable.photoJourneyScan: If Immich does not answer at night, the scan skips this account until the next night and says why here; existing suggestions stay. If the place-name service does not answer, findings stay unnamed instead of being dropped.
